ns2:course.label: Feminist Theories & Methods
ns2:course.description: Interdisciplinary study in diverse feminist theories and methods produced in and across various disciplines. Contemporary philosophical and theoretical developments in the study of gender to specific histories of class, race, ethnicity, nation and sexuality. Prerequisite: At least one graduate-level humanities course or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: At least one graduate-level humanities course or consent of instructor.
